    Bug 1953322 - On Notification dialog disable the elements that aren't shown in system notifications. r=darktrojan
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D241993

diff --git a/mail/components/preferences/notifications.js b/mail/components/preferences/notifications.js
index 617f7e7b167..bbfc781dbca 100644
--- a/mail/components/preferences/notifications.js
+++ b/mail/components/preferences/notifications.js
@@ -13,6 +13,16 @@ Preferences.addAll([
 
 var gNotificationsDialog = {
   init() {
+    const sysAlert = Services.prefs.getBoolPref(
+      "mail.biff.use_system_alert",
+      true
+    );
+    if (sysAlert) {
+      document.getElementById("totalOpenTimeBefore").disabled = true;
+      document.getElementById("totalOpenTime").disabled = true;
+      document.getElementById("totalOpenTimeEnd").disabled = true;
+    }
+
     const element = document.getElementById("totalOpenTime");
     Preferences.addSyncFromPrefListener(
       element,
diff --git a/mail/components/preferences/notifications.xhtml b/mail/components/preferences/notifications.xhtml
index fb8de1f654d..b65f50d74b8 100644
--- a/mail/components/preferences/notifications.xhtml
+++ b/mail/components/preferences/notifications.xhtml
@@ -34,12 +34,6 @@
     <dialog id="NotificationsDialog">
       <description data-l10n-id="customize-alert-description" />
 
-      <checkbox
-        id="previewText"
-        class="indent"
-        data-l10n-id="preview-text-checkbox"
-        preference="mail.biff.alert.show_preview"
-      />
       <checkbox
         id="subject"
         class="indent"
@@ -52,6 +46,12 @@
         data-l10n-id="sender-checkbox"

+      <checkbox
